title: RenderRequest
description: request part of POST /v1/render (render service, optional cloud engine). The phone uploads one trimmed {moment_id}.mp4 per clip; edit_spec is rebased onto those files. Rules the schema cannot express are in README.

edit_spec.description: Rebased edit spec: each clip's in_s/out_s are seconds from the start of the uploaded trimmed file, not the original clip (normally in_s = 0, out_s = original out_s - in_s).

context.description: Trip details for the graphics (titles, lower thirds). Same values as the plan request.

clips.description: One entry per uploaded file, same moment_ids as edit_spec.clips.

duration_s.description: Duration of the uploaded trimmed file.
